hooks.text: 三分钟浪涌后选择满额撤离或继续冒险
hooks.excerpt: Your weapon auto-fires - you dodge, position, and survive. Every 3 minutes a surge hits. Clear it for massive loot. Extract or push deeper - after each surge, a portal opens. Leave safely with 100% rewards, or risk it for bigger payoffs. Die and you lose 25%.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 十八类网格建筑全天候产出与防御
hooks.excerpt: Place 18 building types on a grid. Mines produce Shards. Wells produce Resonance. Turrets and Pylons auto-defend against creature attacks. Forges and Calibrators permanently boost your combat stats. Your Hold runs 24/7 . Come back after sleeping to thousands of resources waiting for you.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 八千共享区域随裂隙扩张并可能集体崩塌
hooks.excerpt: 25 regions. 8,000+ hex zones. One persistent map shared by every player. The Shatter spreads while you're offline - consuming zones, spawning creatures, weakening regions. Your expeditions push it back. Every run you complete reclaims territory for your entire region. Region health drops? The ground starts shaking in real time. Drop below 15%? A 48-hour collapse countdown begins. If it hits zero, everyone is evacuated. Buildings take 50% damage. The stakes are shared. The consequences are real.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
